individualClassifications.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
individualClassifications.reason: Each Port and its mutable null-containing column/fault/bind maps are allocated and consumed by exactly one calling worker; separate Port per concurrent invocation. The malformed-value table is local to one nonparallel Test. No map crosses threads; ConcurrentHashMap would reject required null column vectors.

individualClassifications.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
individualClassifications.reason: Standalone Unit owns two finite workers and25 memory-only iterations each/10s futures; no servlet container/backend task or shared mutable connection state. No Product/server thread ownership changed.

individualClassifications.message: In J2EE, getClassLoader() might not work as expected. Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead.
individualClassifications.reason: JDK java.sql interface defining loader is required to define each visible Connection/Statement/ResultSet Proxy. Host Unit only, no J2EE TCCL/global loader/driver/DB change.

individualClassifications.message: Use equals() to compare object references.
individualClassifications.reason: This is the own Proxy implementation of Object.equals and deliberately returns identity. Calling proxy.equals recursively would reenter the same handler; value equality is not the fixture contract.
